tweets.text:
I just found something that blew my minddddd🤯😭

@adekunleGOLD uses email marketing to connect with his fans? Not the usual “my new song is out” type of mail. I saw the copies and they feel so personal, inspirations, what made him write his songs. Basically like Snapchat stories but in your inbox. 

How do I signup to get a mail🥹? Because that’s next level connection, literally showing up as yourself. 

Now as a Social Media Manager, I thought to myself, this strategy isn’t just for artiste or personal brands. Big brands can do this too. 

~ A food brand can share the story behind a recipe, fun fails in the kitchen, or what inspired a new dish.
~ A SaaS brand can talk about a feature, the team struggles, funny bugs, or a customer story.

The point is people love stories, I love stories, I want to feel included like I know the human behind the brand. 

Anyways I’m obsessed with this idea and I ask again 😔how do I sign up to Adekunle Gold’s mail?

2002 man. I been in the game FOREVER.
